scope: One read-only diagnosis of native Copilot delivery T005/T006 after hosted SDK repair

diagnosis.historical_native_failure: BotServiceRbac authorization requires a valid Entra tenant id for the activity caller.
diagnosis.interpretation: The historical native failure is an ingress Activity-caller identity failure, distinct from the repaired hosted SDK and successful managed-identity downstream calls. The direct request supplied caller identity metadata; it does not establish that the native connector supplies the same metadata.
diagnosis.root_cause_certainty: Historical error is explicit; current connector Activity identity propagation and recovery remain unverified.

supported_endpoint_control.support_level: Documented preview API and SDK; not production GA assurance
supported_endpoint_control.cli_alternative: An authenticated REST call through az rest can carry the documented API request with the Foundry audience explicitly selected; no first-class authentication switch exists in the inspected command.
supported_endpoint_control.array_warning: The authorization_schemes array is replaced, not appended. Preserve the full original array for rollback.
supported_endpoint_control.scope_restriction: Only the isolated verified-retrieval agent endpoint; never the original specialist endpoint, shared connection, roles or parent authentication.
supported_endpoint_control.important_boundary: Entra-only retains Entra token and RBAC requirements but removes Bot Service channel authorization. It is a deliberate trust-boundary change, not a guaranteed native connector repair.
supported_endpoint_control.not_recommended_as_substitute: Do not switch to BotServiceTenant: that enables tenant-wide channel access and has separate publishing and administrator-approval prerequisites.

caller_constraints.endpoint_permission: Actual Entra caller needs Foundry Agent Consumer or an equivalent higher data-plane role at agent or project scope, including valid inherited grants.
caller_constraints.connector_authentication: The connector documents Microsoft Entra ID User Login as non-shareable; Managed Identity authentication is documented for Logic Apps only. A hosted runtime managed identity is not evidence of the Invoker user's connector authorization.
caller_constraints.resource_scoped_permission: The connector additionally documents at least Cognitive Services User on its Azure AI resource. Retain an existing qualifying resource-scoped or inherited grant; project-scoped endpoint access does not automatically prove this prerequisite. Do not add duplicate grants or remove existing grants speculatively.
caller_constraints.operator_arm_read: Inherited role-assignment read succeeded; current operator has inherited Owner assignments. ARM ownership alone is not proof of the connector user's Foundry data-plane permissions.
caller_constraints.native_missing_tenant: Adding roles cannot manufacture a missing Activity caller tenant. Do not forge Activity identity, bypass consent or weaken parent authentication.

native_surfaces.manage: Copilot Studio standard-harness Agents page exposes the connected Foundry agent details and connection; Dataverse Web API readback verifies saved component state, definition hash and connector reference.
native_surfaces.immediate_native_test: Supported Copilot Studio Test pane after the authorized Manage operation; this is draft testing, not proof of a published channel.

documented_evaluation_api.authentication_context: Existing test set plus a signed-in user's Microsoft Copilot Studio profile mcsConnectionId and appropriate toolsConnections; omitting the profile runs unauthenticated.
documented_evaluation_api.required_next_auth_step: Use an appropriately consented, supported client and delegated Power Platform user token. Confirm permissions for the run operation separately; successful Dataverse or Foundry access does not grant them. No consent or app-registration changes were performed.

browser.consequence: The documented UI remains the lowest-change native route, but unattended browser execution is not currently established.

native_surfaces.published_external_testing: For published-channel SDK, DirectLine or Teams acceptance, push and publish the intended parent content before testing. Draft maker evaluation is a separate documented API option, not a published-delivery claim.

recommended_handoff: Manage first establishes a usable supported UI session or appropriately consented PPAPI client; do not start native scoring while both access paths are unavailable.
Before any authorized change, refresh the isolated endpoint snapshot, diagnostic state and hash, and original attachment state and hash. Stop on unexpected drift.

If the caller authorizes the endpoint experiment, Manage applies only the Entra-only authorization array on the isolated stable endpoint and reads it back. Keep Activity protocol, routing, roles and connection unchanged.
Manage may then temporarily enable only the diagnostic through supported Copilot Studio controls. This diagnosis did not enable it.

Test performs one explicit native source-verification request with authenticated Invoker context, correlates parent dispatch to hosted logs, and checks exact whole-record evidence and displayed parent answer.
If native caller authentication still fails, stop rather than improvising caller identity or changing more authentication settings.
After the bounded canary, return the diagnostic to Inactive and verify its exact retained definition hash. Preserve the original Active attachment and its hash throughout.

Restore the isolated endpoint's original Entra plus BotServiceRbac array on failure or at the end of a temporary experiment. Verify readback. Do not claim a native pass remains valid for the restored configuration unless tested under that configuration.
T005/T006 remain incomplete until actual native delivery and rollback acceptance evidence exists.

rollback.concurrency: Refresh snapshots immediately before writing; use applicable concurrency controls and stop on drift. No endpoint concurrency token was established by this diagnosis.

safety.local_deliverables: This sanitized JSON and one private JSON evidence file only.

sanitization: No tenant, organization, subscription, resource or component identifiers, private endpoints, connection identifiers, credentials, full source passages or full native definitions.
